# scc_protection_compliance_rule (Data Source)

Look up an existing ProtectionComplianceRule object. Set identity or name to select it.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `identity` (String) Identity used to look up the object.
- `name` (String) Maps to the -Name parameter.

### Read-Only

- `advanced_rule` (String) Maps to the -AdvancedRule parameter.
- `contains_labels` (String) Maps to the -ContainsLabels parameter.
- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
- `label_actions` (Set of String) Maps to the -LabelActions parameter.
- `policy` (String) Maps to the -Policy parameter.
